author: migration-implementer

problem.summary: All 20 page/viewport screenshots were within 0.381% pixel diff, with 0 new console errors and 0 new HTTP error responses, but the 'new failed network requests on B not present on A' check flagged 20/20 combinations because scripts/migration/visual/run.mjs compared failed requests by exact full URL. The failures were net::ERR_ABORTED Google Analytics / Google Ads / DoubleClick beacons (analytics.google.com/g/collect, www.google.com/ccm|rmkt/collect, ad.doubleclick.net/ccm/s/collect) that also abort on A, but their query strings are randomized per page load (cid/auid session ids, rnd/tft timestamps, cache-busters), so they never matched exactly.

changes.what: Added CANONICAL_PRODUCTION_HOSTS, isFirstPartyHost(), and two new exported pure functions: normalizeFailedRequestKey({url, method, failure}, pageOrigin) and diffNewFailedRequests(failedA, failedB). Cross-origin (third-party) requests key on method + scheme://host + pathname + failure text, dropping the query string (where the per-load randomness lives). First-party requests (host matches the page's own capturing host, or is www.growmax.io/growmax.io) key on method + pathname + search + failure text, dropping the host itself, so A's www.growmax.io capture and B's *.vercel.app capture of the same path+search reconcile instead of every first-party request being flagged as new purely because the hostname differs.

page.on('requestfailed', ...) in captureShots() now also captures req.method() and computes entry.key = normalizeFailedRequestKey(entry, base) at capture time (base = the origin that page/context was actually navigated against), alongside the existing raw url/failure fields.

In main()'s per-page/viewport loop, newFailedRequests is now computed via diffNewFailedRequests(failedA, failedB) (key equality) instead of failedB.filter(f => !failedA.some(fa => fa.url === f.url)). Raw URLs, method and failure text are still kept on every entry in the evidence output (newFailedRequestsOnB); only the comparison itself changed. The unrelated newErrorResponses comparison (HTTP 4xx/5xx responses, not requestfailed events) was left untouched -- it already passed 0-new in P5.2 attempt 2 and is out of scope for this fix.

Guarded the top-level main().catch(...) call with `if (import.meta.url === \`file://${process.argv[1]}\`)` so importing run.mjs (for normalizeFailedRequestKey/diffNewFailedRequests) from the new self-test no longer launches a browser / runs the full suite as a side effect of the import.

New pure, offline self-test (no network, no browser) exercising the real normalizeFailedRequestKey/diffNewFailedRequests exports with synthetic failed-request entries, in the same style as scripts/migration/parity/selftest-p5.3.mjs. 8 cases, all passing (see checks below and docs/migration/evidence/P5.3-visual-selftest.json for the full run).
